args.content: """Manual functional checks for the ctrans extension.""" import pytest from jinja2 import Environment, pass_context from jinja2.exceptions import TemplateAssertionError, TemplateSyntaxError languages = { "de": { "Hello": "Hallo", "One user online": "Ein Benutzer online", "%(user_count)s users online": "%(user_count)s Benutzer online", "User: %(name)s": "Benutzer: %(name)s", } } @pass_context def gettext(context, string): language = context.get("LANGUAGE", "en") return languages.get(language, {}).get(string, string) @pass_context def ngettext(context, s, p, n): language = context.get("LANGUAGE", "en") value = p if n != 1 else s return languages.get(language, {}).get(value, value) def make_env(newstyle=False, autoescape=False): env = Environment( extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n", "jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"], autoescape=autoescape, ) if newstyle: env.install_gettext_callables(gettext, ngettext, newstyle=True) else: env.globals.update({"gettext": gettext, "ngettext": ngettext}) return env def check(label, actual, expected): status = "ok" if actual == expected else "FAIL" print(f"[{status}] {label}: {actual!r}" + ("" if actual == expected else f" != {expected!r}")) return actual == expected results = [] # 1. basic condition true -> translation env = make_env() t = env.from_string("{% ctrans use_i18n %}Hello{% fallback %}Fallback{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("basic true", t.render(use_i18n=True, LANGUAGE="de"), "Hallo")) results.append(check("basic false", t.render(use_i18n=False, LANGUAGE="de"), "Fallback")) # 2. optional commas in header env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n, name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}User: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("comma header", t.render(use_i18n=True, name="Bob", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: Bob")) t2 = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}User: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("no comma header", t2.render(use_i18n=True, name="Bob", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: Bob")) # 3. pluralize env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans use_i18n user_count %}One user online{% pluralize %}" "{{ user_count }} users online{% fallback %}{{ user_count }} users{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("plural 1", t.render(use_i18n=True, user_count=1, LANGUAGE="de"), "Ein Benutzer online")) results.append(check("plural 2", t.render(use_i18n=True, user_count=2, LANGUAGE="de"), "2 Benutzer online")) results.append(check("plural fallback", t.render(use_i18n=False, user_count=2, LANGUAGE="de"), "2 users")) # 4. pluralize with explicit variable env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag, count=5 %}One item{% pluralize count %}{{ count }} items{% fallback %}{{ count }} fb{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("explicit plural var", t.render(flag=True), "5 items")) results.append(check("explicit plural var fb", t.render(flag=False), "5 fb")) # 5. explicit variable assignment env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag name=full_name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}Plain: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("explicit assign", t.render(flag=True, full_name="Ann", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: Ann")) results.append(check("explicit assign fb", t.render(flag=False, full_name="Ann"), "Plain: Ann")) # 6. missing fallback -> TemplateSyntaxError with message env = make_env() try: env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}Hello{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("missing fallback", "no error", "TemplateSyntaxError")) except TemplateSyntaxError as e: msg = str(e) results.append("expected 'fallback' block" in msg) print(f" msg: {msg}") # 7. unclosed block -> TemplateSyntaxError env = make_env() try: env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}Hello") results.append(check("unclosed", "no error", "TemplateSyntaxError")) except TemplateSyntaxError as e: msg = str(e) results.append("unclosed conditional translation block" in msg) print(f" msg: {msg}") # 8. duplicate variable -> TemplateAssertionError env = make_env() try: env.from_string("{% ctrans flag x, x %}Hello{% fallback %}X{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("dup var", "no error", "TemplateAssertionError")) except TemplateAssertionError as e: msg = str(e) results.append("defined twice" in msg) print(f" msg: {msg}") # 9. trimmed env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{%- ctrans flag trimmed %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb\n text {% endctrans -%}" ) results.append(check("trimmed true", t.render(flag=True), "hello world")) results.append(check("trimmed false (fallback trimmed too)", t.render(flag=False), "fb text")) # 10. notrimmed env = make_env() t = env.from_string( "{%- ctrans flag notrimmed %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb {% endctrans -%}" ) results.append(check("notrimmed true", t.render(flag=True), " hello\n world ")) results.append(check("notrimmed false", t.render(flag=False), " fb ")) # 11. trimmed policy env = make_env() env.policies["ext.i18n.trimmed"] = True t = env.from_string( "{%- ctrans flag %} hello\n world {% fallback %} fb {% endctrans -%}" ) results.append(check("policy trimmed", t.render(flag=True), "hello world")) results.append(check("policy trimmed fb", t.render(flag=False), "fb")) # 12. newstyle env = make_env(newstyle=True) t = env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}Hello{% fallback %}Fb{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("newstyle true", t.render(flag=True, LANGUAGE="de"), "Hallo")) results.append(check("newstyle false", t.render(flag=False), "Fb")) env = make_env(newstyle=True) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag, name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}Plain: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("newstyle vars", t.render(flag=True, name="Bob", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: Bob")) results.append(check("newstyle vars fb", t.render(flag=False, name="Bob"), "Plain: Bob")) # 13. newstyle plural env = make_env(newstyle=True) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag user_count %}One user online{% pluralize %}" "{{ user_count }} users online{% fallback %}{{ user_count }} users{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check("newstyle plural 1", t.render(flag=True, user_count=1, LANGUAGE="de"), "Ein Benutzer online")) results.append(check("newstyle plural 3", t.render(flag=True, user_count=3, LANGUAGE="de"), "3 Benutzer online")) results.append(check("newstyle plural fb", t.render(flag=False, user_count=3), "3 users")) # 14. autoescape oldstyle: translation is safe, vars escaped env = make_env(autoescape=True) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag, name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}Plain: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check( "autoescape true", t.render(flag=True, name="", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: <x>", )) results.append(check( "autoescape false", t.render(flag=False, name=""), "Plain: <x>", )) # 15. autoescape newstyle env = make_env(newstyle=True, autoescape=True) t = env.from_string( "{% ctrans flag, name %}User: {{ name }}{% fallback %}Plain: {{ name }}{% endctrans %}" ) results.append(check( "autoescape newstyle true", t.render(flag=True, name="", LANGUAGE="de"), "Benutzer: <x>", )) results.append(check( "autoescape newstyle false", t.render(flag=False, name=""), "Plain: <x>", )) # 16. percent signs env = make_env() t = env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}100%% sure{% fallback %}50%% fb{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("percent true", t.render(flag=True), "100% sure")) results.append(check("percent false", t.render(flag=False), "50% fb")) # 17. condition expressions env = make_env() t = env.from_string("{% ctrans count > 5 %}big{% fallback %}small{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("cond expr 6", t.render(count=6), "big")) results.append(check("cond expr 3", t.render(count=3), "small")) env = make_env() t = env.from_string("{% ctrans not flag %}no{% fallback %}yes{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("cond not", t.render(flag=False), "no")) results.append(check("cond not2", t.render(flag=True), "yes")) # 18. alias import from jinja2.ext import conditional_i18n, ConditionalI18nExtension results.append(check("alias", conditional_i18n is ConditionalI18nExtension, True)) results.append(check("tags", ConditionalI18nExtension.tags, {"ctrans"})) results.append(check("identifier", ConditionalI18nExtension.identifier, "jinja2.ext.ConditionalI18nExtension")) # 19. extension by string name env = Environment(extensions=["jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n", "jinja2.ext.i18n"]) env.globals.update({"gettext": lambda s: s.upper(), "ngettext": lambda s, p, n: p if n != 1 else s}) t = env.from_string("{% ctrans on %}hello{% fallback %}fb{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("string ext name", t.render(on=True), "HELLO")) results.append(check("string ext name fb", t.render(on=False), "fb")) # 20. ctrans only (no i18n extension) - newstyle_gettext default env = Environment(extensions=["jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"]) env.globals.update({"gettext": lambda s: s.upper()}) t = env.from_string("{% ctrans on %}hello{% fallback %}fb{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("ctrans only", t.render(on=True), "HELLO")) # 21. unknown pluralize variable env = make_env() try: env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}x{% pluralize bar %}y{% fallback %}z{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("unknown pluralize var", "no error", "TemplateAssertionError")) except TemplateAssertionError as e: results.append("unknown variable" in str(e)) print(f" msg: {e}") # 22. control structures in block -> error env = make_env() try: env.from_string("{% ctrans flag %}{% if x %}a{% endif %}{% fallback %}z{% endctrans %}") results.append(check("control in block", "no error", "TemplateSyntaxError")) except TemplateSyntaxError as e: results.append("control structures" in str(e)) print(f" msg: {e}") print() print(f"{sum(results)}/{len(results)} checks passed") if not all(results): raise SystemExit(1)

from jinja2 import Environment

seen = []
env = Environment(extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n", "jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"])
env.globals["gettext"] = lambda s: seen.append(("get", s)) or s
env.globals["ngettext"] = lambda s, p, n: seen.append(("nget", s, p, n)) or (s if n == 1 else p)

def show(label, source, **ctx):
    seen.clear()
    print(label)
    print("  source:", source)
    print("  out:   ", repr(env.from_string(source).render(**ctx)))
    for call in seen:
        print("  call:  ", call)

show("std no vars", "{% trans %}100%% done{% endtrans %}")
show("std vars", "{% trans x %}100%% done {{ x }}{% endtrans %}", x=1)
show("ctrans no vars true", "{% ctrans f %}100%% done{% fallback %}50%% fb{% endctrans %}", f=True)
show("ctrans no vars false", "{% ctrans f %}100%% done{% fallback %}50%% fb{% endctrans %}", f=False)
show("ctrans vars", "{% ctrans f x %}100%% done {{ x }}{% fallback %}50%% fb {{ x }}{% endctrans %}", f=True, x=1)
EOF

from jinja2 import Environment
from jinja2.exceptions import TemplateSyntaxError, TemplateAssertionError

env = Environment(extensions=["jinja2.ext.i18n", "jinja2.ext.conditional_i18n"])

bad = [
    "{% ctrans %}x{% fallback %}y{% endctrans %}",          # no condition
    "{% ctrans flag %}",                                     # unclosed mid-block
    "{% ctrans flag %}x{% fallback %}y",                    # missing endctrans
    "{% ctrans flag %}x{% pluralize %}y{% fallback %}z",    # missing endctrans after fallback
    "{% ctrans flag %}x{% fallback z %}y{% endctrans %}",   # fallback with args
    "{% ctrans flag %}x{% fallback %}y{% endctrans %}",     # valid (control)
    "{% ctrans flag %}x{% fallback %}y{% fallback %}z{% endctrans %}",  # double fallback
]
for src in bad:
    try:
        env.from_string(src)
        print(f"OK     {src!r}")
    except (TemplateSyntaxError, TemplateAssertionError) as e:
        print(f"ERR    {src!r} -> {type(e).__name__}: {e.message if hasattr(e, 'message') else e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"UNEXPECTED {src!r} -> {type(e).__name__}: {e}")
EOF
